title: "Menu Aakhri Wari Mil Baba"

---

Menu Aakhri Wari Mil Baba Na Jagh Tay Fayr Bulavaan Gi.

Tera Zakhmi Chehra Vaikh Lavaan
Firr Duniya Ton Turr Javaan Gi.

Main Panchiyan Vaangoon Vich Pinjaray Paiy Kalleyan Takraan Maraan
Teri Yaad Ich Ro Ro Kay Baba Main Dinn Tay Raat Guzaaran
Main Jaan Diyan Teray Baaj Kaddi
Naa Baba Main Sukh Pavaan Gi.

Ghutt Paani Aap Main Nayi Peeta Sajaad Day Zaiwar Tharay
Unna Tapp Diyan Haye Zanjeeran Nay Meray Veer Day Maas Utaaray
Udde Khoon Day Athroo Poonj Di Raye
Marr Kay Na Dard Bhulavaan Gi.

Lahoo Dull Da Ay Howay Dard Barraa Jurri Zakhmaan Naal Pushaa Kay
Jinna Zulfaan Nu Tu Chumm Da Say Unna Zulfaan Day Vich Khaak Ay
Jithay Shimr Tamaachay Maaray Nay
Baba Rukhsaar Vakhaavaan Gi.

Mera Sirr Howay Tereay Seenay Tay Jadon Niklay Haye Dum Baba
Tera Seena Maiton Vichar Geya Eho Kha Geya Hay Ghum Baba
Na Socheya Si Teray Baad Kaddi
Inj Raitan Vich Kurlaawan Gi.

نہ سوچیا سی تیرے بعد کدی

from pathlib import Path
import re
s = Path('src/data/lyrics/menu-aakhri-wari-mil-baba-nw-262549570793.md').read_text()
_, front, body = s.split('---\\n', 2)
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for section, numbers in [(roman, list('1234')), (body, list('۱۲۳۴'))]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in re.split(r'\\n\\s*\\n', section.strip())]
    assert [len(block) for block in blocks] == [1, 2, 5, 5, 5, 5]
    assert [block[0].strip() for block in blocks[2:]] == numbers
    assert not any(line.endswith(('.', ' ')) for block in blocks for line in block)
assert all(line.startswith('  ') for line in roman.splitlines() if line)
assert '\\u200c' not in body
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 19 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions retain the opening and four matching numbered stanzas.

Updated the language metadata to reflect the Punjabi verse and removed the missing-source tag. I read the ambiguous Roman phrases “zaiwar tharay” and “pushaa kay” as زیور ٹھارے and پوشاک اے. Only the selected lyric was edited.
